title: Introduce dependency-aware metadata rollback and excerpted release drafts
author: Ava Martinez
release_notes: Add a dependency-aware metadata rollback tool and a chronicle exporter that generates concise, excerpted release drafts for model onboarding. Backwards-compatible CLI and operator hooks. No breaking API changes.
description: Motivation: onboarding metadata can transitively mutate downstream artifacts (aliases, compatibility hints, affinity tags) which in turn pollutes release notes and can cause confusing churn in model catalogs. This PR introduces two orthogonal features: 1) a dependency-aware metadata rollback engine that uses the model dependency graph to revert only transitive metadata deltas while preserving direct author edits; 2) a chronicle exporter that synthesizes excerpted release drafts highlighting the minimal set of meaningful changes for release managers. Scope: library + CLI + operator hook + small web UI preview. Design summary: we compute a directed dependency graph at ingest time, tag metadata deltas with provenance and a TTL, and provide a selective revert operation that accepts an allowed-provenance whitelist and an impact threshold. The chronicle exporter runs an impact scoring pass against a configurable checklist (latency regressions, tokenizer changes, compatibility tags, dataset license updates) and outputs a compact markdown-like draft suitable for editing or direct publishing to the release pipeline. Backwards compatibility: existing onboard contracts and profile formats are supported; the rollback is opt-in and guarded by feature flag "metadata.rollback.v1". CLI: `redwood-registry chronicle export --model-id <id> --since <tag> --excerpt-only --out draft.md`. Operator hook: `onboard-processor` gains a new step `chronicle-seed` that stores the draft alongside the metadata snapshot. Implementation notes: added an in-memory graph builder with fallbacks to provenance-ledger lookups for large catalogs, lightweight diff/patch applier, new REST endpoints (/api/v1/metadata/rollback, /api/v1/chronicle/export), and a preview renderer used by the console. Tests: unit coverage for graph traversal, integration test for rollback safety (ensures direct author edits are not reverted), e2e export smoke tests. Rollout plan: feature-flag gated rollout to 10% of tenants for 2 weeks, collect onboard audit diffs, then ramp to 100% pending no regressions. See linked Linear tasks for rollout details.
